description.value: Osaka Sushi is a Japanese restaurant on Burrard Street in Vancouver offering sushi, sashimi, donburi, noodles, hot pot, and more. The menu emphasizes fresh, globally sourced ingredients across a wide range of traditional and contemporary Japanese dishes. OSM notes both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a convenient stop on one of Vancouver's major cycling corridors.
